glass: small stemmed wine glass (about 200 ml), chilled, fine sugar on the outside of the rim, lined inside with a collar of lemon peel, no ice
version: v1.2 (round 4 step 1, 2026-10-04; drink unchanged since v1): a Brandy Crusta, stirred, on the Oxford Companion's recipe (pdf 610: 60 brandy, 5 rich simple syrup, 3 orange curaçao, 2 dashes aromatic bitters, 3-5 lemon, stirred, sugar-rimmed small wineglass, half-lemon peel collar), with a little more curaçao and less lemon. Ours: 60 cognac steeped 20 min with black tea (the spark: tannin; steep time after LI pp. 268-269 but unwashed, Codex p. 94), 5 rich syrup, 5 dry orange curaçao, 2.5 lemon (3 ml and 5 ml read OUT on the stirred acid band), 2 dashes Angostura. No maraschino (nuts).
